title: Former US Surgeon General Vivek Murthy to lead Common Sense Media’s youth AI safety push
key_facts: Common Sense Media named former US Surgeon General Dr. Vivek Murthy to chair its Youth AI Safety Institute.
Murthy served as Surgeon General 2014-2017 and 2021-2025 and has been on Common Sense's board since October 2025.
The institute will develop child-safety standards, test AI products, and publish scorecards and risk assessments.
Common Sense research: 59% of children and teens use AI to search for information; 55% for homework; more than half of US teens regularly chat with an AI companion (2025).
Center for Democracy & Technology: 42% of students use AI for mental health support or escape.
Funders include Anthropic and the OpenAI Foundation; the institute says it keeps editorial independence.
quote_evidence: "This is a today problem, not a tomorrow problem," Murthy said.
Common Sense Media acknowledges that some funders produce AI products the institute may test.
why_it_matters_hint: Independent public testing of AI products used by children, led by a known public-health figure.
notes: Single trade outlet plus LinkedIn quotes.
